summary: casecheck's self-test lines of a profile's disks, each fault in a private copy of cases.c or of the case schema found by its own line

argv: ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O1 -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/include -I utils tools/etude/casecheck.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/cases.c tools/etude/digest.c tools/etude/judge.c tools/etude/json.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/schema.c tools/etude/verdict.c tools/etude/history.c tools/etude/history_json.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/casecheck && mkdir -p ${WORK}/schemas && cp tools/etude/schemas/*.json ${WORK}/schemas/ && cp ${SRC}/tools/etude/schemas/case.schema.json ${WORK}/schemas/case.schema.json

d=$TMPDIR/selftest && mkdir -p $d/fixtures && cp tools/etude/fixtures/disks.json tools/etude/fixtures/disks-bad.json tools/etude/fixtures/disks-shape.json $d/fixtures/ && grep -F ' ./disks' tools/etude/fixtures/expect > $d/fixtures/expect && ln -s ${WORK}/schemas $d/schemas && ${WORK}/casecheck --selftest $d/fixtures; s=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $s

faults.name: twice
faults.summary: a disk given twice in a profile is not reported

lines: | twice: the disk stick is given twice in a profile

faults.name: count
faults.summary: disks that the launcher does not attach together are not reported

lines: | ide-five: the launcher attaches at most 8 disks of a profile
| nine: the launcher attaches at most 8 disks of a profile

faults.name: empty-artifact
faults.summary: an empty disk with the name of a prepared artifact is not reported

lines: | empty-artifact: the empty disk stick is an artifact that prepare lists

faults.name: sizes
faults.summary: an empty disk given two sizes is not reported

lines: | empty-sizes: the empty disk big is given two sizes

faults.name: empty-prepared
faults.summary: an empty disk is required to be a prepared artifact

faults.name: cd-name
faults.summary: the name of a disk given as an object is not looked for in prepare

lines: | cd-unprepared: the disk nothing-built is no artifact that prepare lists

faults.name: nvme-serial
faults.summary: the schema takes an NVMe disk without a serial

faults.name: ide-serial
faults.summary: the schema takes a serial on IDE

lines: | /disks/1: has "serial", which this form does not allow

faults.name: cd-bus
faults.summary: the schema takes a CD on NVMe

faults.name: cd-size
faults.summary: the schema takes a CD that is an empty disk

lines: | /disks/3: has "size_bytes", which this form does not allow

faults.name: cd-discard
faults.summary: the schema takes a CD with discard

faults.name: serial-length
faults.summary: the schema takes a serial of 21 characters

faults.name: serial-comma
faults.summary: the schema takes a serial with a comma

faults.name: bus-usb
faults.summary: the schema takes a bus the launcher does not attach

lines: | /disks/7/bus: "usb" is not one of the values the schema allows

faults.name: open
faults.summary: the schema takes a disk with a member it does not define

lines: | /disks/8/format: is a member the schema does not allow
